title: Visions From Above
description: Gain the **Invoke the Divine** Cleric Starting Move if you don't already have it, except your deity's Domain is Knowledge. Choose your deity's worshippers and enemies as detailed in the Move.

outcomes.text: Add Knowledge to your deity's domains. Is this a new aspect of your deity, a result of your unique connection to them, or something else?

submoves.title: Guidance
submoves.description: Now and at the start of each session, roll 1d6 as your Fate Die and keep its result. Once per scene, after someone rolls for a Move (not for dmg or similar), you may switch one die with your Fate Die. The die that was switched out becomes your new Fate Die.

title: Haruspication
description: When you **ritually sacrifice something important**, ask your deity one question about your sacrifice or something associated with it (owners, loved ones, history, etc.), and roll+wis.

outcomes.text: Your deity shows you a vivid vision that answers your question fully.
The vision is cryptic and it'll need deciphering.
Your vision includes an omen of doom; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
When you **Sense Motive**, you can also ask one of the following questions, even on a 6-.
bullets: What are your true feelings about me?
What do you not want to admit (to me, to another, to yourself, etc.)?
Who or what do you care for most of all?

title: Sacred Truth
description: Once per session, when you **publicly reveal the truth about a secret or mystery**, gain 1 Depth with your deity. If someone present doesn't want it known, you also gain **adv** on your next rolled Move against them.

title: A Moth to the Sacred Flame
description: When you **willingly expose yourself to an enemy attack**, roll+cha; if you're vulnerable while doing so, roll with **adv**.

outcomes.text: They boast and babble at you, and you can ask any two questions about them or their superiors.
You can ask one question, but after answering they'll turn to violence.
They're far more cunning or powerful than they appear (GM's call); mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
